en.headline: Police recover gold swapped for fabric softener in Kwun Tong hotel
en.dek: Officers say about 30 kilograms of gold grains, valued at 30 million dollars, were taken from a hotel room and later found in Tai Po.
body: Police have arrested two men over the theft of gold grains worth about 30 million dollars from a hotel in Kwun Tong, and say the metal has been recovered.

A mainland man reported the case in the early hours of Wednesday. He told officers that he and a mainland friend had checked into the hotel with about 30 kilograms of gold grains in their luggage. He later found the gold gone and eight bottles of fabric softener of similar weight in its place. His companion had disappeared.

Kwun Tong district crime chief inspector Tang Tsz-hin said the theft was planned. He said the man who travelled with the victim is believed to have been the principal, and to have arranged for two other men to buy the softener in advance and book a neighbouring room. When the victim went downstairs for a cigarette, the companion opened the door and the other men removed the gold, Tang said. The group then used different forms of transport, which he said was an attempt to throw the inquiry off course.

Officers reviewed closed-circuit footage and arrested a man in Tai Po at midday on Wednesday. A room card for a guesthouse in the district was found on him, and police recovered all of the gold from that room. A second man was arrested at Lo Wu Control Point as he tried to leave Hong Kong. The two men, aged 27 and 41, are mainland residents on two-way permits and are being held for investigation.

Police believe the companion, described as a friend who had worked with the victim for several months, left Hong Kong before the report was made. He is being sought. The victim, also on a two-way permit, is understood to buy and sell gold mainly through licensed dealers.

zh.headline: 觀塘酒店金粒被掉包成柔順劑 警拘兩男起回失金
zh.dek: 警方表示，約30公斤、值約3000萬元的金粒在酒店房間被偷走，其後在大埔賓館起回，兩名持雙程證男子被扣查。
body: 警方破獲一宗涉及約3000萬元金粒的盜竊案，拘捕兩名男子，並表示涉案黃金已全部起回。
一名內地男子周三清晨報案，指自己與一名內地友人入住觀塘區酒店，行李內有約30公斤金粒。其後金粒不翼而飛，換成8支重量相若的柔順劑，同行友人亦失去蹤影。
觀塘警區刑事總督察鄧子軒說，案件經過策劃。他指報案人的友人涉嫌是主腦，安排另外兩名男子預先購買柔順劑，並預訂相鄰房間。報案人落樓吸煙的短時間內，友人開門讓兩人入房取走黃金。犯案後各人登上不同交通工具，鄧子軒說此舉是試圖擾亂調查方向。
警方翻查閉路電視後，周三中午在大埔拘捕一名男子，在他身上搜出區內賓館房卡，並在房間起回全部涉案黃金。另一名男子在羅湖管制站企圖出境時被捕。兩人分別27歲及41歲，為持雙程證的中國籍男子，正被拘留調查。
警方相信與報案人同行、合作了數月的友人，在報案前已經離境，目前正追緝。報案人同樣持雙程證，據了解主要在持牌機構買賣黃金。
